verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke has a dedicated Patents practice page describing drafting/filing-adjacent work through litigation, FRAND/SEP disputes, and pan-European/UPC strategy, with named case experience (Unwired Planet, Optis v Apple) and a UPC decision tracker tool. However, the evidence emphasizes litigation and dispute strategy more than prosecution/drafting specifics, and no named individual practitioner bios are cited. Missing for 10: explicit mention of patent drafting/application filing services and named partner/practitioner profiles.
